accepted.sentence: During lock servicing, a hand tool removes the small fasteners holding a lock case together so its mechanism can be inspected.
To mount curtain rods, installers turn fasteners through brackets into wall anchors, securing supports above windows.
On a boat, crew members use a hand-operated implement to secure hatch latches with threaded fasteners.
Flat-pack shelving assembly often requires turning supplied fasteners through connector plates to join upright panels and shelves.
An exercise-equipment technician tightens the small fasteners that hold a console housing to its support arm.
At a greenhouse, workers use a hand tool to fasten braces and panels when assembling metal growing racks.
Pool maintenance crews may use one to secure ladder fittings after checking that their mounting hardware is sound.
A repair technician removes housing fasteners from a fishing reel to reach its internal gears for inspection.
